title: Chimera-X
tagline: Chimera-X is an AI Agent that lets Users Maximize their yield automatically using Intents
description: Chimera-X offers advanced yield optimization strategies designed to help users maximize their returns efficiently. Users have the flexibility to choose between fully automating the yield maximization process or manually executing transactions based on their individual preferences and strategies. By leveraging cutting-edge algorithms and smart automation tools, Chimera-X ensures that users can optimize their yield with minimal effort while maintaining full control over their investment decisions. Whether they prefer a hands-off approach or a more hands-on strategy, Chimera-X provides the necessary tools and insights to enhance their financial outcomes effectively.
how_its_made:
Front End : 
Made using NextJs + Onchain kit. The Onchain kit components power every transaction interactions the users do mannually.

Backend : 

Made using Nodejs + AgentKit + Nillion : 
Agentkit acts as the backbone of Chimera-X. WE use custom tools to execute Liquidity submissions and withdraws. Nillion is used to securely hold the Agent Private Key to automate Transaction Executions
